verdicts.reason: A works as a left-to-right banner, but the subhead breaks into an awkward three-line stack ('Every / mixed / case.'). The product is tiny inside its circle, the fine print is jammed against the circle, and there is a dead strip on the far right. B is worse: 'off' nearly touches the 'Every mixed case' subhead, which looks like a collision. Its circle is clipped at the top and bottom, the can runs off the bottom edge, and the fine print floats far away on the right with no connection to the rest.
